description: Main FastAPI application for the ClothingRecommendationService frontend. Defines endpoints for health check, travel advice retrieval, and a demo page, managing dependencies and integrating with backend clients.

methods.name: lifespan(app: FastAPI)
methods.description: Async context manager to handle startup/shutdown of backend client resources.

methods.name: BackendClient get_backend_client()
methods.description: Dependency provider for injecting BackendClient into request handlers.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Endpoint to perform a health check, returning service status.

methods.name: TravelAdvice get_travel_advice(body: CityQuery, client: BackendClient = Depends(get_backend_client))
methods.description: Endpoint to get travel advice based on a POST request body containing city info.

methods.name: TravelAdvice get_travel_advice_q( city: str = Query(..., min_length=1, description="City name."), client: BackendClient = Depends(get_backend_client), )
methods.description: Query-parameter variant of travel advice endpoint accepting city as URL query parameter.

methods.name: HTMLResponse demo()
methods.description: Serves an HTML page demonstrating the service's front-end functionality.

methods.name: websocket_help()
methods.description: Provides WebSocket information; indicates that no WebSocket endpoints are available.
